                                                            Skip to content               Home » Annual Check-up Programmes               ✨ Translated by AI          Annual Check-up Programmes                          Annual Check-ups at BNH Hospital: Comprehensive Healthcare with BNH's Annual Check-up Packages              Good health starts with proper and consistent care. BNH Hospital focuses on comprehensive, accurate, and modern health check-ups, with a team of expert physicians in various specialties and advanced medical technology. This allows you to take care of your health with confidence, whether you need a general health check-up or an in-depth check-up based on individual risk factors. To maximise the effectiveness of health check-ups, BNH Hospital has designed health check-up packages suitable for different age groups, lifestyles, and specific health concerns. Health check-ups are divided into two main approaches: Age-based health check-ups Lifestyle-based and specific health concern-based health check-ups With a selection of 8 packages, you can receive targeted care, prevent diseases before symptoms occur, and achieve the best possible treatment outcomes.               Click to select and read information about the Annual Health Check-up at BNH Hospital.                             Why Choose BNH Hospital for Your Health Check-up? 
BNH Provides International Standards and Exceptional Care              BNH Hospital is not just a medical facility, but a premium healthcare centre that combines leading medical experts and cutting-edge technology to provide accurate, in-depth, and tailored health check-ups for every lifestyle. Centre of Specialists with Advanced Technology – BNH Hospital has a team of experts in various specialties ready to provide care with modern and effective medical technology. You will receive care from specialists who specialise in your specific health concerns, whether it is internal medicine, cardiology, diabetes and endocrinology, gastroenterology, or neurology. Every case is examined, analysed, and consulted in-depth by specialists to ensure accurate health check-ups and maximise benefits for patients. 127 Years of Trust – BNH has provided expert care and extensive experience for over 127 years. We have earned the trust and confidence of patients both domestically and internationally. Our Complete Care service covers every aspect of health. At BNH, we don’t just look at test results; we analyse your health comprehensively with a commitment to preventing diseases proactively. “Tailored to Your Specific Needs” Health Check-up Programs – Health check-ups at BNH offer a variety of programs based on age, lifestyle, and specific health concerns that require special attention. We also design personalised health check-up lists in collaboration with specialists. After your health check-up, you will receive a personalised health check-up plan for the following year, ensuring comprehensive and beneficial check-ups. Comprehensive Services and Attentive Care for Every Detail of Your Health – Our medical team dedicates ample time to analyse and recommend long-term health care plans. We provide comprehensive services from preventive health check-ups to treatment and rehabilitation.                           Age-Based Health Check-up Groups              Our bodies change with age, leading to different risks for diseases and health problems. BNH Hospital offers health check-up programs designed for each age group to help you receive comprehensive and appropriate healthcare, including early disease prevention. Youth (Under 25 Years Old) – Explorer Package Men & Women: Special Price 10,900 Baht (from the regular price of 18,700 Baht) Early Career (25-35 Years Old) – Builder Package Men: Special Price 12,900 Baht (from the regular price of 22,100 Baht) Women: Special Price 15,900 Baht (from the regular price of 26,700 Baht) Working Age (35-50 Years Old) – Mentor Package Men: Special Price 27,900 Baht (from the regular price of 49,800 Baht) Women: Special Price 32,900 Baht (from the regular price of 59,000 Baht) Aged 50 and Over – Giver Package Men: Special Price 34,900 Baht (from the regular price of 58,300 Baht) Women: Special Price 39,900 Baht (from the regular price of 66,200 Baht)                           1. Youth (Under 25 Years Old) – Explorer Package              A health check-up package for young people starting to take care of their health, aiming to maintain fitness and be ready for all activities. Special Price 10,900 Baht (from the regular price of 18,700 Baht) The health check-up program focuses on basic examinations to assess overall health. The health check-up package for those aged 25-35 years covers the risk of non-communicable diseases such as high blood pressure, heart disease, high cholesterol, and diabetes early on. Age-based health check-ups allow doctors to recommend disease prevention and health care guidelines that are appropriate for each stage of life effectively.                                             Lifestyle and Specific Health Concern-Based Health Check-up Groups              In addition to age factors, our health is also influenced by lifestyle and individual risk factors. If you have risk factors or concerns about the health of your heart, lungs, and brain, BNH Hospital offers health check-up packages designed to meet your diverse needs, with 4 main packages: Lungs Focus Package (Lung and Respiratory Health Check-up) – Suitable for those concerned about lung health, smokers, those in polluted environments, or those with a family history of lung cancer. Men: Special Price 45,000 Baht (from the regular price of 71,800 Baht) Women: Special Price 49,900 Baht (from the regular price of 79,500 Baht) Advanced Heart Package (Heart Health Check-up) – Suitable for those who want to check their heart health specifically, such as those at risk of heart disease. Men & Women: Special Price 39,900 Baht (from the regular price of 55,900 Baht) Total Heart & Lungs Package (Comprehensive Heart and Lung Health Check-up) – Suitable for those who want a holistic check-up of their heart and lungs, those over 50 years old, or those with a history of chronic non-communicable diseases, high blood pressure, high cholesterol, and long-term diabetes. Men: Special Price 52,700 Baht (from the regular price of 83,100 Baht) Women: Special Price 55,700 Baht (from the regular price of 90,800 Baht) Total Heart & Lungs Plus Brain Package (Comprehensive Heart, Lung, and Brain Health Check-up) – Suitable for those who want an in-depth check-up of the heart, lungs, and brain. Men: Special Price 74,900 Baht (from the regular price of 107,000 Baht) Women: Special Price 77,900 Baht (from the regular price of 114,700 Baht)                           1. Lungs Focus Package (Lung and Respiratory Health Check-up)              Men: 45,000 Baht (from the regular price of 71,800 Baht) Women: 49,900 Baht (from the regular price of 79,500 Baht) A comprehensive health check-up package focusing on early lung cancer screening with low-dose lung computed tomography for those aged 50 and over. Service duration is approximately 6-8 hours. ✅ Who is it suitable for? Smokers or former long-term smokers, especially those with a smoking history of 20 pack-years or more, or those living with smokers. (Pack-year calculation: number of packs smoked per day x total number of years smoked) Those who work or reside in areas with high PM 2.5 dust and air pollution for extended periods. Those who have been exposed to chemicals or radiation for a long time. Those with chronic cough, shortness of breath, or suspected lung problems. Those with a direct family history of lung disease or lung cancer. Advanced Heart Package (Heart Health Check-up)              💰 39,900 Baht (from the regular price of 55,900 Baht) A heart check-up package by a cardiologist for those aged 50 and over, or those with a family history of cardiovascular disease, or those with underlying conditions such as diabetes, high blood pressure, or high cholesterol. Service duration is approximately 3-4 hours. ✅ Who is it suitable for? Those with chest tightness, palpitations, or easy fatigue. Those with a family history of heart disease or coronary artery disease. Those with risk factors such as high blood pressure, diabetes, or high cholesterol. Those with a high-stress lifestyle, insufficient sleep, or lack of exercise. Athletes or those who exercise strenuously regularly and want to check their cardiovascular fitness. Seniors or those who want an early-stage disease prevention check-up. Those who work hard, lack of rest, and require for a holistic health check-up. Total Heart & Lungs Plus Brain Package (Comprehensive Heart, Lung, and Brain Health Check-up)              Men: 74,900 Baht (from the regular price of 107,000 Baht) Women: 77,900 Baht (from the regular price of 114,700 Baht) A comprehensive check for heart and lung disease risks, including brain and cerebrovascular examination with magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) for those aged 50 and over for targeted prevention and treatment. Service duration is approximately 8-10 hours. ✅ Who is it suitable for? Those with risk factors for stroke, such as high blood pressure, diabetes, or high cholesterol. Those who have experienced dizziness, temporary weakness, or memory loss. Those who want an in-depth health check-up of the brain, heart, and lungs simultaneously. Those with a family history of stroke, paralysis, or paresis. Those who want early screening for serious diseases for effective prevention. Elevate Your Health with Personalised Check-up Programs from BNH Hospital              At BNH Hospital , we prioritise thorough and accurate disease detection with a medical approach that emphasises preventive and holistic healthcare. We design comprehensive and diverse health check-up packages to perfectly meet individual needs. Beyond general health check-ups, every examination at BNH Hospital provides not only your current health information but also a starting point for long-term health care. After receiving your annual health check-up results, our medical team will collaborate with you to plan a personalised health check-up program for the following year, considering your risk factors, lifestyle, and physical condition to ensure every examination is accurate, targeted, and highly beneficial.                                Preparing Before Health Check-up              For the most accurate results, specific preparation is required before certain tests and /or investigations as listed below: Blood testing for sugar and cholesterol level Please refrain from consuming any food and drink including snacks, candies, and chewing gum for 10-12 hours (except sips of water), and do not consume any alcoholic beverages for 72 hours before the test. Urine Examination For women, please avoid urine examination during menstrual period. The sample can be collected at least 3-5 days after menstrual period. Imaging diagnosis Please notify our staff in advance if you have any of these conditions If you are pregnant or may be pregnant If you are allergic to contrast media, seafood, and/or any other medications If you are wearing a pacemaker or any medical device (for MRI) Stool examination Please contact the Advanced Diagnostic Centre on 4 th floor for stool collection kit and instructions before your health check up appointment date, as the sample must be returned within 2 hours after collection for the most accurate laboratory test result. Cervical cancer screening The screening should not be done during your menstrual period. Please refrain from sexual intercourse 1 day before the screening. Ultrasound of upper and lower abdomen Please refrain from eating any food for 4-6 hours prior to the procedure in case of ultrasound of lower abdomen. Please drink plenty of water as a full bladder is needed for better visualisation. Exercise stress test/Stress echocardiogram Please make an appointment before the examination On the day of the examination, please wear trousers and bring your own sports shoes for your convenience during the test. On the day of the examination, please refrain from taking any medications that affect the heart rate Please do not consume any caffeine beverages before the test Fibro scan (Liver scan for fatty liver and fibrosis) Please do not consume any food for 2 hours prior to the test Ultrasound carotid artery No specific preparation is required. Please make an appointment before the examination. CT chest low dose No specific preparation is required. Please make an appointment before the examination. CT scan for calcium scoring No specific preparation is required. Please make an appointment before the examination. Eye examination (Giver, Lungs Focus, Total Heart & Lungs, and Total Heart & Lungs Plus Brain) After your eyes have been fully dilated, you may experience blurry vision for 6-8 hours. Driving and reading are not recommended during this period until your eye sight returns to normal and your eyes feel more comfortable. For your safety, it is recommended to bring a relative to assist you home and to wear sunglasses to help comfort your eyes. MRA & MRI Brain (Heart & Lungs Plus Brain) No specific preparation is required. Please make an appointment before the examination. In case the change of appointment date is required, please notify at least 2 days in advance during 1-4 pm. See list of strictly necessary cookies        Analytical / Performance cookies    Analytical / Performance cookies       Allow us to monitor the performance of our websites by determining the number of page views and the number of unique users a website has. Web analytics services are performed so as to analyse patterns of user behaviour and we use that information to enhance user experience or identify areas of the website which may require improvement. Nonetheless, the information is anonymous (i.e. it cannot be used to identify you and does not contain personal information such as your name and email address) and it is only used for statistical purposes. With this information, thereby we can customise our website based on your preferences, provide enhanced, more personal features to facilitate your visit. Such information collected by these cookies is usually anonymised, hence we cannot identify you personally.
